text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—*pant... gasp...*!!
Just a little further...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I can win, I can win... I will win...!
Go, go, go...!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh!
Dammit, dammit, dammit, DAMMIIIT...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Dammit... Persistent, aren't they.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I know what the cause is.
...It's that these three centimeters still won't move.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(My fate to lose by 7 cm hasn't changed at all.
In the end, my future is...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...No, no. The numbers changed.
Frankly, even that shouldn't be possible."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I gotta do this.
Otherwise..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ――Eek?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a tremendous crash behind me,
I whirled around in a panic...
to find Meisho Doto had tumbled over.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm okayyy~...
I fell down so many times today that
my butt's completely flat nowww."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, more importantly...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, there was something I wanted
to discuss with Shakur-san's Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...It's about Shakur-san.
It seems... she's been having frequent nightmares.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly bolt awake in the middle of the night.
Lately, it's gotten especially bad...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Um. So please...
Take good care of Shakur-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
You might not like me bringing this up out of nowhere, Shakur-san...
But still...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even though you take such good care of me,
I can't do anything on my own...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I thought maybe you could help Shakur-san, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...I'm tellin' ya, I don't expect a damn thing from your abilities."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"The same goes for your ideas.
I don't expect a damn thing, but even if it's zero, having one is different from having none."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I don't feel like I've truly been a positive influence on her. Even so, when she said 'you can help me,' I wanted to nod with firm resolve."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
!
Phew...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"So you can get a good night's sleep, Shakur-san...
I'll be careful about how I fall out of bed too~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Air Shakur is having nightmares,
then the fear inside her must be quite profound.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Parcae" predicts that after the Kikuka Sho, I won't win a single race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how terrifying must it be to head toward
a point where you know you'll sink?
I can only imagine. But even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And even at this very moment...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tsk. Are there any new values changing?
Ugh, this "991031021222"
is seriously in the damn way!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just swap the whole table...
No, that won't work. I used that exact same trick before, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even her occult stuff is fine.
Anything, if it has even the slightest influence...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...No, no, noooo!
Aaaaaahhhhhh.........

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ......Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The truth is, I made it to 3cm... Just a bit more... There's gotta be something. If not—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: If I don't...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...
Damn it, gotta start over.
choice_data_list: (Is there really nothing I can do?)
(Is there really nothing I can do?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Can I really do nothing but watch as she charges straight into the flames—
Is that truly all I can do?
